# Bridge command reference

Every command the bridge answers — 112 of them. Send one with
`./gerda ctl send <name> '<json args>'` or the `mc_send` MCP tool; a running bot serves the
same set as the `describe` command and the `mc://api` MCP resource. Where two layers declare
one name, the container row wins, as in dispatch (`harness/main.js#buildManifest`).

Arguments marked **required** must be present; the rest are optional. A command whose
description starts with `DIAG:` is a diagnostic probe and is listed under
[Diagnostic](#diagnostic) instead of under its layer. The dispatch path behind the layers:
[IPC.md](IPC.md).

## Bridge

`harness/bridge.js` — Answered by the TCP gateway itself, so they work while main.js is deaf or stale.

| Command | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bridge_diag` | — | stable-layer health answered by bridge.js itself (service running-states + heartbeats + revs); works even when main is deaf/stale |
| `ping` | — | connectivity test → pong, answered by bridge.js itself |
| `restart_service` | `name` string — service: main\|worker\|bridge (default main) | restart a jsMacros service via ServiceManager, bypassing main — recovers a stale/deaf main that can't restart itself |

## Container

`harness/main.js` — The supervisor's own commands: diagnostics, worker lifecycle, eval, and the eyes/hands primitives of `harness/screen.js`.

| Command | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `chat` | `message` string **required** | send any text/command to chat — drive mod & Baritone commands (/home, /sethome, /back, /warp, /tp, #goto …) via one generic passthrough |
| `click` | `i` int — button index<br>`text` string — label substring<br>`x` int — GUI x = pixel/guiScale<br>`y` int — GUI y = pixel/guiScale<br>`button` int — 0=left 1=right | click: real Screen.mouseClicked at GUI coords (x,y = screenshot-pixel/guiScale; drives FTB/custom GUIs), or a button by i/text |
| `close_screen` | — | close the open GUI screen |
| `describe` | — | this manifest — meta + live worker commands |
| `diag` | — | one-call topology/health: live handlers+ext, worker heartbeat age, per-file deploy drift (bootRev vs disk). Main-local — works when the worker is dead |
| `eval` | `code` string **required** | sandboxed JS eval (World/Player only) |
| `get_logs` | `n` int — lines, default 100 max 500 | tail the NDJSON journal |
| `get_state` | — | pos/health/dim/tool/worker snapshot |
| `goto` | `x` int **required**<br>`y` int **required**<br>`z` int **required** | raw Baritone #goto x y z (movement primitive) |
| `halt` | — | hard stop + #stop Baritone |
| `introspect` | `filter` string<br>`target` string — 'screen' to dump open-screen/button methods | dump jsMacros method names (debug) |
| `inventory` | — | FULL carry inventory: per-slot list + per-id totals (carry), hotbar detail, ore/tool summary |
| `jeval` | `code` string **required** | PRIVILEGED raw eval — full jsMacros/Java scope (Java.type, Client, mod APIs); loopback only |
| `key` | `key` string **required** — e.g. key.inventory, key.drop<br>`hold` bool<br>`release` bool | press a named keybind |
| `keypress` | `code` int **required**<br>`scancode` int<br>`mods` int | raw GLFW key to the screen (Enter=257 Backspace=259 Esc=256) |
| `knowledge` | `sig` string — world signature; default = current world<br>`all` bool — return every world section + the signature list | read world-scoped knowledge (waypoints/resources/stats) for the current or a given world signature |
| `knowledge_set` | `sig` string<br>`waypoints` array<br>`resources` array<br>`stats` object | merge waypoints/resources/stats into world-scoped knowledge (read-modify-write; other worlds + unspecified sections untouched) |
| `latest_screenshot` | — | path+mtime of newest screenshot PNG |
| `load` | `code` string **required** | load a passive module (runs in parallel) |
| `poll_events` | `since` int — last seq seen (0/omitted = all currently buffered) | drain the bounded event ring since a cursor → {events, seq}; pass the returned seq next time |
| `read_screen` | — | open GUI: title + button widgets (text/pos/active) |
| `reload_ext` | `path` string — override ext file path<br>`code` string — inline ext code instead of the file | re-eval ext.js (reloadable mod-API plugins: EMI/prospector/FTB) WITHOUT reloading main.js — ship new mod commands via sync + this |
| `reload_main` | `delay` int — ms before restart, default 1000 (lets the response flush first) | restart the main supervisor service itself (re-reads main.js from disk; headless GUI-free reload). Use after editing main.js; ext.js uses reload_ext |
| `reload_worker` | `name` string<br>`delay` int — ms between stop and start, default 1500 | idempotent worker reload = halt+start as ONE off-thread command (never deaf-locks main like a blocking halt can). Prefer this over manual halt→start; scripts/ops/reload_worker.py drives it |
| `scan` | `radius` int<br>`scan_y_range` int | read-only ore scan around player |
| `screenshot` | `name` string — filename (default ai_shot.png) | native in-game screenshot (jsMacros Player.takeScreenshot → screenshots/ai_shot.png; works unfocused while rendering) |
| `scroll` | `x` int<br>`y` int<br>`amount` int — default -3 (down) | scroll the open screen at (x,y); amount +up/-down notches |
| `services` | — | list registered jsMacros services |
| `start` | `name` string | start the worker service (loads bundle) |
| `status` | — | container + module status |
| `stop` | — | graceful stop of the worker |
| `type` | `text` string **required** | type text into the focused widget (click a search box first) |

## Ext plugins

`harness/ext.js` — Mod-API plugins, reloaded live with `reload_ext`.

| Command | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `assign` | `allowed` object — {minX,maxX,minZ,maxZ} or null=whole world<br>`forbidden` array — [{minX,maxX,minZ,maxZ}, …] peer claims to avoid<br>`claimedVeins` array — [{x,z}, …] vein columns peers are drilling (drill skips near them)<br>`hazards` array — [{kind,x,z}, …] fleet-union hazard columns (treated like own recorded hazards) | push a fleet assignment (hub→bot, fleet hub assignment): XZ region this bot may mine + peer-claimed regions/veins to avoid + fleet-shared hazards |
| `cam_aim` | `yaw` number **required**<br>`pitch` number **required**<br>`roll` number — dutch angle, degrees (vanilla has none)<br>`smooth` number — per-frame ease 0..1 (1 = snap, 0.15 ≈ soft pan) | Hold the camera at an absolute yaw/pitch every FRAME (Forge ViewportEvent hook). Eases toward the angle by `smooth`; survives the player's own rotation. |
| `cam_free` | — | Release the camera hook — vanilla/spectator control again. The listener stays registered but stops writing angles. |
| `cam_hud` | `hide` boolean — default true | Hide/show the HUD on this client (vanilla F1 + the jsMacros overlay). Always hide before a take. |
| `cam_look_at` | `x` number **required**<br>`y` number **required**<br>`z` number **required**<br>`roll` number<br>`smooth` number | Aim the camera at a world point every FRAME. Poll it (~4 Hz) with a moving subject's position for a smooth tracking pan — the easing does the interpolation. |
| `cam_pose` | `x` number **required**<br>`y` number **required**<br>`z` number **required**<br>`yaw` number<br>`pitch` number<br>`spectator` boolean — also /gamemode spectator @s | Place the CAMERA client (op) at x/y/z with an optional yaw/pitch, optionally switching to spectator. Vanilla /tp — camera client only, never a bot. |
| `cam_spectate` | `target` string — player name; omit to release | POV shot: vanilla /spectate <player\|uuid> so the camera rides a bot's eyes (smooth, no code). Omit target to release. |
| `cam_state` | — | Camera hook state: mode, registered?, eased angles, and the per-frame counter (must climb at FPS, not 20/s). |
| `count_item` | `item` string **required** — item id, e.g. minecraft:iron_ingot | read-only: total count of an item id across the whole carry inventory (hotbar + main) |
| `drawer_deposit` | `pos` array **required** — [x,y,z] of the drawer block<br>`items` array|string — only deposit these ids (whitelist)<br>`keep` array|string — never deposit these ids (used when no whitelist) | slot-aware deposit of inventory items into a Functional Storage drawer (X_1/2/4): routes each item to its matching slot or an empty one via look-aim + use; main-inv stacks staged via hotbar; verify-read deferred a tick. items=whitelist, keep=blacklist |
| `emi_recipe` | `item` string **required** | EMI: open recipe GUI for what CRAFTS this item |
| `emi_search` | `text` string **required**<br>`limit` int | EMI item search (headless): set search text → return matching item ids as data |
| `emi_uses` | `item` string **required** | EMI: open recipe GUI for where this item is USED |
| `go_base` | `name` string | FTB Essentials /home <name> — teleport to the bot's saved base home (default name 'base'). Fire-and-forget — verify the move. |
| `grid` | `axis` string — xz (top-down, default) \| xy \| zy (vertical profiles)<br>`radius` int — in-plane half-size (default 8, max 20)<br>`y` int — xz: the Y level (default bot feet)<br>`z` int — xy: the fixed Z (default bot)<br>`x` int — zy: the fixed X (default bot)<br>`h` int — vertical: Y half-height (default = radius) | ASCII block-slice of the world (X-ray): axis xz=top-down (default), xy/zy=vertical profile; air=. ore=O bot=@, dynamic legend for the rest |
| `interact_entity` | `uuid` string — target entity uuid (wins over pos)<br>`pos` array — [x,y,z] block cell — nearest matching entity within radius<br>`entity` string — entity-type substring filter (default 'item_frame'; NOT `type` — that's the envelope field)<br>`radius` number — pos search radius (default 2.0)<br>`item` string — item id to hold + place (default: keep held)<br>`verify` string — consumed \| none (default: consumed if item given, else none) | right-click a held item onto an ENTITY (vanilla item frame / armor stand — unreachable via interact_place's block path). Target by uuid, or nearest type-matching entity near pos (type default item_frame). verify=consumed (held stack dropped) or none. |
| `interact_place` | `pos` array **required** — [x,y,z] of the target block<br>`item` string — item id to hold + place (default: keep held)<br>`face` string — up/down/north/south/east/west (default: toward the player)<br>`verify` string — consumed \| none (default: consumed if item given, else none) | right-click a held item onto a block face (item frame / display / pedestal / lever). Aims the face centre (default: side toward the player) + interactBlock; verify=consumed (a held stack dropped — frames/displays) or none (dispatch only). The headless primitive of the interact mission. |
| `jm_refresh` | — | live-reload JourneyMap's waypoint list from disk (WaypointStore.reset) so bot-written waypoints appear without a relog |
| `journeymap_sync` | — | mirror the bot's waypoints + discovered veins into JourneyMap as visible waypoints (writes journeymap/data/sp/<save>/waypoints/<id>.json, JM's own id scheme) + live-refresh |
| `markers` | `ore` string — vein/ore kind filter<br>`near` int<br>`sig` string — world signature; default = current world | query accumulated ore markers (mc_world.json resources, current world) sorted by distance |
| `ore_registry` | `namespace` string — filter to one mod namespace (e.g. gtceu) | LIVE ore-block ids from the Forge registry (forge:ores tag ∪ *_ore id scan) — the generator behind config/ores_live.json |
| `prospect` | `want` string<br>`keep_open` bool | run HV prospector: hold→scan→wait→extract veins as data→cache→close; returns resources + nearest vein per ore |
| `prospector_status` | `lowPct` int — low-energy threshold %, default 15 | read-only: hotbar prospector stored energy (charge/max/pct + low flag) — recharge before it dies |
| `quest_claim` | `quest` string **required** — 16-hex quest id whose rewards to claim | MUTATING: claim ONLY the named quest's rewards (ClaimRewardMessage per reward). Never claims other quests' rewards |
| `quest_complete` | `task` string — 16-hex task id (submit just this task)<br>`quest` string — 16-hex quest id (submit all its tasks) | MUTATING: submit FTB quest task(s) (SubmitTaskMessage). Item tasks need the item already in inventory (legal, not consumed when consume_items=false) |
| `quests` | `chapter` string — filter by chapter filename (e.g. 'genesis')<br>`quest` string — filter to one quest by 16-hex id (case-insensitive) | read-only FTB Quests live status (completion/deps/unclaimed per quest+task) — the objective engine's FTB status feed |
| `read_chat` | `lines` int — max lines (default 20)<br>`filter` string — case-insensitive substring filter | read recent received chat lines as data (newest first, optional substring filter) |
| `recipe` | `item` string **required**<br>`limit` int — max recipes (default 5)<br>`craftOnly` bool — only crafting-table ≤3×3 recipes (default true)<br>`alts` bool — include per-cell ingredient alternatives (capped; default false — they explode for wood) | resolve craft recipe(s) for an item as DATA via EMI (grid + ingredients + output) — headless, pack-correct; feeds scripts/dev/resolve_craft_chain.py |
| `reflect` | `expr` string **required** — JS expr evaluated in ext scope, e.g. "Player.openInventory()"<br>`filter` string — case-insensitive substring filter on member names OR their Mojang annotation (e.g. "Rot" finds m_146922_ →setYRot)<br>`sig` bool — include param/return signatures (default true)<br>`fields` bool — include public fields (default true)<br>`mojang` bool — annotate SRG names (m_…/f_…) with Mojang names via srg_names.json (default true)<br>`depth` int — recurse into member types this many levels (0-2, default 0) | reflect any expression's runtime class — method signatures, fields, optional recursion (API-exploration tool, generalizes introspect) |
| `rtp` | — | FTB Essentials /rtp — random teleport |
| `sethome` | `name` string | FTB Essentials /sethome [name] — set a home at the current position |
| `spawn` | — | FTB Essentials /spawn — teleport to world spawn |
| `storage_add` | `pos` array **required** — [x,y,z] of the container block<br>`kind` string — drawer\|chest\|barrel\|container (auto for drawers)<br>`facing` string — drawer face override: north\|south\|east\|west | manually register one container in the storage network (auto-detects drawer kind/facing; pass kind/facing to override) |
| `storage_list` | — | list the registered storage-network containers for the current world |
| `storage_remove` | `pos` array — [x,y,z] to remove<br>`all` bool — clear the entire registry for this world | remove a container from the storage network by position (or all=true to clear the registry) |
| `storage_scan` | `radius` int — horizontal scan radius (default 6, max 16)<br>`height` int — vertical scan range ± (default 4, max 8) | scan a cube around the bot for containers (drawers/chests/barrels) and register them in mc_world.json storages (drawer contents recorded live). Hybrid discovery — pair with storage_add/storage_remove |
| `tool_info` | `slot` int — hotbar index 0-8 (default: held) | decode held/slot tool NBT → durability + AoE (GT.Behaviours) + GTCEu stats (GT.Tool) + electric charge |
| `tp_waypoint` | `name` string<br>`ore` string<br>`x` int<br>`y` int<br>`z` int | fast-teleport: {x,z[,y]} coords \| {name} waypoint \| {ore} nearest vein (vanilla /tp; veins land at current Y). Fire-and-forget — verify the move. |
| `unassign` | — | clear this bot's fleet assignment (mine anywhere again) |
| `use_item` | `item` string — item id to equip first (else uses held)<br>`look_down` number — pitch degrees (e.g. 80 to aim at the ground before placing)<br>`clicks` int — how many short right-clicks (default 1) | equip an item to the hand and tap key.use (right-click); optional look_down pitch + repeat clicks |
| `warp` | `name` string **required** | FTB Essentials /warp <name> — fast travel to a named warp |
| `wp_add` | `name` string **required**<br>`x` int **required**<br>`z` int **required**<br>`y` int<br>`kind` string<br>`dim` string | add a JourneyMap waypoint live via the native API (WaypointStore.add) — visible immediately, no file/reload. dim defaults to current, y to player Y, kind sets color |
| `wp_list` | — | list JourneyMap waypoints live (from WaypointStore.getAll) |
| `wp_remove` | `name` string **required** | remove JourneyMap waypoint(s) by name via the native API (WaypointStore.remove) — immediate |

## Worker bundle

`src/bot/entry/worker-bundle.ts` — Gerda Bot's own commands, answered by the kernel inside the loaded bundle.

| Command | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `add_waypoint` | `name` string<br>`kind` string<br>`x` int<br>`y` int<br>`z` int | record a waypoint (at the player, or at x/y/z) |
| `continue` | — | approve the pending plan step (alias: proceed) |
| `goto_waypoint` | `name` string — default: nearest vein | send the bot to a known vein, then mine it |
| `metrics` | — | write the telemetry .prom snapshot now + log its path |
| `mission_abort` | — | stop the active mission → IDLE |
| `mission_start` | `name` string **required**<br>`params` object | activate a mission by name (switchable at runtime, no reload) |
| `mission_status` | — | log the active mission + phase |
| `missions` | — | log the available mission names |
| `nav_engine` | `engine` string — default\|astar\|dstar\|auto (omit → report current) | set the navigator engine for production GOTO (no redeploy) — D* Lite only engages on filler-free legs |
| `pause` | — | pause the bot → PAUSED |
| `plan_abort` | — | abort the plan + active mission → IDLE |
| `plan_start` | `name` string **required** | load + start a registered plan (the orchestrator chains its mission steps) |
| `plan_status` | — | log the plan, cursor, status, blocked reason, active mission |
| `plans` | — | log the available plan names |
| `proceed` | — | approve the pending plan step (alias: continue) |
| `remove_waypoint` | `name` string **required** | remove a waypoint by name |
| `resume` | — | resume the bot from PAUSED |
| `run` | — | flip the plan to auto and drain to completion (or until a guard blocks) |
| `save_now` | — | flush persistence to disk |
| `select` | `step` string — step index or id (jump)<br>`mission` string — run this mission ad-hoc<br>`params` object | jump to a plan step, or run a single mission ad-hoc |
| `smoke` | `eat` bool — also dispatch one real bite (destructive) | live facade smoke test (worker context): logs SMOKE per check + SMOKE_DONE |
| `step` | — | advance exactly one plan step, then wait for approval again |

## Diagnostic

Probes for testing and debugging; most are idle/paused only.

| Command | Layer | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `greedy_drive` | worker | `x` int **required**<br>`y` int **required**<br>`z` int **required** | per-tick greedy nav to x/y/z (continuous veto; safe live test) — idle/paused only |
| `greedy_drive_stop` | worker | — | clear the per-tick greedy target + release keys |
| `greedy_stop` | worker | — | release the greedy navigator's movement keys (abort) |
| `greedy_to` | worker | `x` int **required**<br>`y` int **required**<br>`z` int **required** | drive one tick of the greedy navigator toward x/y/z — call repeatedly |
| `nav_trace` | worker | `tail` int — return only the last N rows | dump the un-sampled per-tick parkour trace of the last greedy_drive |
| `sensors` | worker | `items` array — item ids to report stock for<br>`includeStorage` boolean — also count the open container's storage slots (default carry only) | live read-out of the sustain-loop sensors — vein exhaustion + item stock (the cycle's guards) |
| `set_arrival` | worker | `dist` number — e.g. 0.4 for exact-block | runtime arrival tolerance for greedy_drive (≤0 clears → cfg.nav.gotoArrivalDist) |
| `set_dstar` | worker | `on` bool — force the D* Lite incremental engine<br>`noFiller` bool — strip bridge/pillar/mine so D* engages | per-drive engine override for greedy_drive A/B — D* Lite engine + strip filler moves |
| `set_timeout` | worker | `ticks` number — e.g. 3000 (~150s) | runtime timeout (ticks) for greedy_drive — raise for a long natural traverse (≤0 clears → cfg.nav.gotoTimeoutTicks) |
| `storage_probe` | worker | `x` int **required**<br>`y` int **required**<br>`z` int **required** | read a placed container's contents from the worker thread (kind/facing/slots) |
| `trace` | worker | `on` bool — omit → report current state | toggle per-tick decision tracing (T:TICK lines in get_logs) without a reload |
